CREATE TABLE public.agent_episodes (
	episode_id UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
	agent_id STRING NOT NULL,
	tenant_id STRING NOT NULL,
	kind STRING NOT NULL,
	content JSONB NOT NULL,
	embedding VECTOR(8) NULL,
	created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now():::TIMESTAMPTZ,
	is_authority BOOL NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
	CONSTRAINT agent_episodes_pkey PRIMARY KEY (episode_id ASC),
	VECTOR INDEX idx_agent_episodes_embedding (agent_id, embedding vector_l2_ops),
	INDEX idx_agent_episodes_agent_time (agent_id ASC, created_at DESC),
	INDEX idx_agent_episodes_kind (kind ASC),
	CONSTRAINT check_is_authority CHECK (is_authority = false)
) WITH (schema_locked = true) LOCALITY REGIONAL BY TABLE IN PRIMARY REGION;
